name: Open Bandit Dataset
description: Open Bandit Dataset, about 26 million ZOZO bandit logs across three campaigns with a uniform-random slice. Inverse-propensity and self-normalized inverse-propensity reward. Saito et al., NeurIPS 2021 Datasets and Benchmarks. Logs not vendored.
citation: Saito et al., NeurIPS 2021. Open Bandit Dataset.

license.notes: CC BY. Logs not vendored. The OBP library is a separate pipeline at https://github.com/st-tech/zr-obp.
